title: NextBurn predictions for the four FM2 burns (Flammability of Materials on the Moon)
status: Published before FM2 results exist. FM2 is manifested for a CLPS lunar delivery (NTRS 20240015307); no FM2 results had been reported on the freeze date.
fm2_conditions_source: NTRS 20240015307 (FM2 poster): two SIBAL fabrics burned in air (21% oxygen at 14.7 psia) and two acrylic rods in 34% oxygen at 8.2 psia, one of each upward and downward
decision_rule: Answer only when (a) a test of the same family lies within distance 1.0, where 3 oxygen points, a 30% pressure change, 0.08 g or an opposite flame direction each count as 1.0, (b) the 90% interval of the probability is no wider than 0.6, and (c) no test within distance 1.0 had the opposite outcome to the model's answer. Otherwise decline and name the nearest tests.

scoring_rule.sustained_definition: the flame spreads away from the igniter and is still burning 10 s after the igniter turns off
scoring_rule.scoring: Each answered burn is falsified if the observed outcome is the opposite of its decision. All four probabilities, including declined ones, are scored with the Brier score; each outcome is also checked against its 90% interval.

reasons: the model's answer contradicts FM2 team lunar-g simulation at distance 0.02 (extinguished)

analog.source: LUCI lunar-gravity spin burn of SIBAL in air at normal pressure (rows R001, R002)
analog.tolerance: plus or minus 50% (team judgement for sample and hardware differences; not a statistical interval)
analog.falsified_if: the flame-base spread rate is outside 0.46 to 1.38 mm/s, or the flame-tip spread rate is outside 0.55 to 1.65 mm/s

reasons: no thick plastic test within distance 1.0 (nearest 2.41: Saffire VI-3)
